items.title: Relationships before programs
items.summary: Every build starts from a real relationship a fellow already holds, not from an imagined user.
items.body: Thread's work is woven from long-term, unconditional relationships. When a fellow builds a tool, it should deepen a relationship that already exists — a young person and their Family, a volunteer and their neighborhood — never substitute for one. Ask first: whose relationship does this serve, and how will they feel it?
